what: Phase 1b reproduction of the organizers' RadioWNet: stage 1 150 epochs, stage 2 50 epochs, one model per band, 3 weight seeds
metric: masked RMSE in dB over valid pixels, official val split (2,330 maps per band), organizers' score_submission.py @ fa3ef9b8
selection: best checkpoint by mixlab's per-epoch validation on the same official val split (selection and reporting share the split)

schedule_probe.what: one 5.8 GHz model (weight seed 0), same machine (Apple M4 Max), same mixlab binary (v0.123.0) and init, 50+50 vs 150+50 epochs; official val, organizers' scorer

metal_check.what: the 415 MHz seed-0 stage-2 checkpoint, predicted on Apple Silicon (M1 Max, mixlab v0.131.0) with this README's step 5, scored with the organizers' scorer

float64_check.what: the 415 MHz seed-0 stage-2 checkpoint on 80 val maps against the reference module evaluated in float64 on CPU; max abs difference per pixel, dB
